# Colyseus browser client

Bundled from official `@colyseus/sdk` 0.18.8. This ES module loads only when the
user connects to an online room. Dependencies and their licences are recorded in
`third-party-notices.txt` and included in the production distribution.

Regenerate after installing server dependencies:

```powershell
node tools/bundle-multiplayer-client.mjs
```

Source: https://github.com/colyseus/colyseus.js
